articles.title: A series of bizarre incidents are redefining corporate risk
articles.description: For decades, corporate risk came in familiar forms. Oil prices spiked. Interest rates rose. A competitor launched a better product. A regulator changed the rules. Companies built playbooks for all of this. But the events of the last few weeks have pose an existential question that every company board must have an answer to.

articles.title: India's current account deficit seen widening to USD 57 billion in FY27 on higher imports: ICICI Bank
articles.description: India's current account deficit (CAD) is expected to widen to USD 57 billion, or 1.4 per cent of GDP, in FY27 as stronger domestic demand and higher oil prices keep imports elevated despite robust export growth, according to a report by ICICI Bank.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s billion-dollar wipeouts are becoming a familiar sight
articles.description: Bitcoin liquidation events exceeding $500 million have become common, reflecting significant market volatility. Recent trading sessions have seen large losses, including a $1.3 billion liquidation. Factors affecting the market include high oil prices and potential Federal Reserve rate hikes. Additionally, investors seem to be favoring artificial intelligence stocks over cryptocurrencies amid a tech selloff. These trends indicate an evolving landscape in the crypto trading environment.
